title: Ghost Replay
description: See exactly how you died in the form of a ghost replay
body:
## Ghost Replay

Inspired by Ezio's spectral memories in *Assassin's Creed*.

When you die, the mod records your last 10 seconds, position, head, pose,
equipment, swings, hurt flashes. After respawn, when you return near the death
spot, a ghost wearing **your own skin** manifests at that
location and re-enacts your final moments. Plays three times, then fades.

### Features

- Captures last 10 seconds of your previous life up till moment of death.
- Renders a ghost with your real skin (slim/wide auto)
- Ghost that glows bright and has a blue outline
- Eerie messages
- Armor, held items, and capes rendered
- Lazy spawn: ghost appears only when you return within 32 blocks of death
- Persists across server restarts (one pending ghost per player)
- Visible only to you, other players never see your ghost
- Configurable record window, loop count, spawn radius, alpha

### Configuration

`config/ghostreplay.json` (created on first launch):

| Key             | Default      | Meaning                           |
|-----------------|--------------|-----------------------------------|
| `recordSeconds` | `10`         | How many seconds to record        |
| `loopCount`     | `3`          | Times the ghost replays           |
| `spawnRadius`   | `32`         | Blocks from death to trigger      |
| `tintColor`     | `"#4488FF"`  | Ghost color                       |
| `alpha`         | `0.6`        | Ghost transparency (0..1)         |

### Install side

**Both sides.** Dedicated server and every connecting player's client both need the jar.
Singleplayer: one install covers both.
